policy.data:
package sigstore
    default isCompliant = false
    isCompliant {
      matches := [a | a := input.predicate.annotations[_]; startswith(a.comment, "zcutils:unsigned-executable-bundle:sha256=")]
      count(matches) == 1
      matches[0].comment == "zcutils:unsigned-executable-bundle:sha256=afcd58e2676990271f2077540c78403857a220b086dc7cbc79a9150e417bc4fc"
    }
